scripts.electron:compile: tsup electron/main.ts --format esm --outDir dist-electron --external electron && tsup electron/preload.ts --format cjs --outDir dist-electron --external electron
scripts.electron:dev: pnpm electron:compile && concurrently --kill-others "sh -c 'if lsof -iTCP:3334 -sTCP:LISTEN -n -P >/dev/null; then echo \"[api] Reusing existing server on :3334\"; tail -f /dev/null; else node server/chat-api.mjs; fi'" "sh -c 'if lsof -iTCP:3333 -sTCP:LISTEN -n -P >/dev/null; then echo \"[web] Reusing existing dev server on :3333\"; tail -f /dev/null; else vite --port 3333 --strictPort; fi'" "wait-on tcp:3333 tcp:3334 && electron ."
